==Skin Trivia==
*The {{Color|Other|Badlands}} skin is based on multiple enemies that appear in [[Badlands II]], with the humanoid appearance being based on the [[Husk]] enemy, while the outfit worn by it at Level 5 is based on the [[Gunslinger]] enemy.
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Retired}} skin is based on [[w:c:breakingbad:Walter White|Walter White]] from the ''Breaking Bad'' franchise.
*The {{Color|Premium|Agent}} skin is likely a reference to [[w:c:hitman:Agent 47|Agent 47]] from the ''Hitman'' game series.
** On Level 0-4 is bears resemblance to the [[w:c:hitman:Tuxedo|Tuxedo]], but the black fedora and shades would have come from the [[w:c:hitman:The Public Enemy Suit|The Public Enemy Suit]] and [[w:c:hitman:Italian Suit|Italian Suit]], and Level 5 is similar to [[w:c:hitman:Black %26 White Tuxedo Set|Black & White Tuxedo Set]] or [[w:c:hitman:Requiem Suit|Requiem Suit]] with a full of white color.

*The {{Color|Premium|Kasodus}} skin is based on a Roblox developer, animator and YouTuber [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCtDHfViM8cjis3qP4jO3qNg Kasodus].
**The former {{Color|Premium|Kasodus}} icon uses a grey cloak, which was only used on the skin from Level 3 onwards.
**The outfit, and previously the guns and animations used by the {{Color|Premium|Kasodus}} skin is a reference to [[w:c:megamitensei:Protagonist_(Persona_5)|Joker]] from ''Persona 5''. 
***This was also heavily emphasized in Kasodus's [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w5X4tLM-Qjo trailer] about the skin, using ''Persona 5'' colors (Red, Black and White), music and, in the end, an audio of [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/for-his-neutral-special-he-wields-a-gun Joker's neutral special meme] from ''Super Smash Bros. Ultimate''.
*The first version of the {{Color|Halloween2019|Pumpkin}} skin may have been based on the Headless Horseman.
*The first, second and third {{Color|Golden}} skin used the same design as the {{Color|Premium|Redemption}}, just with some parts being re-colored golden.
** The second and third versions of the Level 5 {{Color|Golden}} and {{Color|Premium|Redemption}} skins appearance are based on the original Level 0-4 appearance of these skins.
**Additionally, the first versions of the {{Color|Golden}} and {{Color|Premium|Redemption}} skins holstered revolvers which were not used to attack enemies until Level 4.
*The first, second, third and fourth version {{Color|Premium|Kasodus}} weapon resembles a newer version of the M1911, though the creator insists that it is the KSC TT33, which is an airsoft gun based on the [[wp:TT pistol|TT-30]] pistol.
*The third and fourth version {{Color|Premium|Kasodus}} skin color used to have its arms be tan instead of the intended pale. Because of this it could have four possible variants, these are: 
**Skin is entirely pale.
**Left arm is tan.
**Right arm is tan.
**Both arms are tan.
*Before the [[v1.4.0|Wanted Dead Update]], most of the skins gained shades at Level 5 that had enemies in their reflection. However, most of the enemies did not resemble any enemy in the game.
*Level 0-2 '''Cowboy's''' animation cocks the revolver after shooting but it appears that the hammer is not pulled back after doing so.
*In the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] the '''Cowboy''' gained an idle animation where it would throw its dual revolvers into the air and then catch them mid air. This would later be removed in the [[v1.4.0|Wanted Dead Update]].
*The {{Color|Premium|Bandit}} skin is based on the [https://riskofrain2.wiki.gg/Bandit ''Risk of Rain 2'' character of the same name].
*The {{Color|ContentCreator|MegaBit}} skin is based on [https://www.youtube.com/@megabit016 Megabit], formerly known as Megalodon.
*The {{Color|Null|Vampire Hunter}} skin may be a reference to [[w:c:hellsing:Alucard|Alucard]] from ''Hellsing''.
*The {{Color|Shamrock|Shamrock}} is the first skin does not having received a dual wield on Level 4 with it's Default skin animation.
*The {{Color|Premium|Most Wanted}} skin was made Gab7497,<ref name="mostwanted">https://x.com/Gab7497/status/2100979942251020754</ref> its concept art was made  by Daddydonuts,<ref>https://x.com/Daddydounts/status/2101004860392985056</ref> faces were made by tyronedag0at_<ref name="mostwanted"/> and the hair and folds were made by itsjsnebula.<ref name="mostwanted"/>

===Roblox Catalog=== 
*The first versions of the Default and {{Color|Halloween2019|Pumpkin}} skins used revolvers that were {{RLinkC|97885508|The General's .45}} from the Roblox catalog, just without the ivory handle.
**The first version of the Default skin used a hat that was the {{RLinkC|23635644|Quickdraw Cowboy}} accessory from Roblox catalog.
*The {{Color|Golden}} skin and {{Color|Premium|Redemption}} skin previously used the {{RLinkC|343619993|Don't Wake Me Up}} face from the Roblox catalog.
**The first versions of the Level 0-5 {{Color|Premium|Redemption}} and {{Color|Premium|Bandit}} skins wore the {{RLinkC|4036726888|Black Stetson Cowboy Hat}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
**The third versions of the Level 5 {{Color|Golden}} and {{Color|Premium|Redemption}} skins wore a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|425117435|Fancy Black Cowboy Hat}} from the Roblox catalog.
**The first and second version of the {{Color|Golden}} skin (and formerly the {{Color|Premium|Redemption}} skin) uses the {{RLinkC|4319701394|Western Wheat}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The CB-64 model used by the {{Color|Premium|Redemption}}, {{Color|Premium|Bandit}} and {{Color|Golden}} skins was the {{RLinkC|95354304|Sten Gun}} from the Roblox catalog.
**Despite the name stating that it is a [[wp:Sten|Sten]] submachine gun, it is actually based on the Spanish copy of the [[wp:Sterling submachine gun|Sterling]] submachine gun, the CB-64.
*The pumpkin head used by the first version of the {{Color|Halloween2019|Pumpkin}} skin was the {{RLinkC|2413966157|Sinister M.}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
* The face used by the first, second and third version {{Color|Premium|Kasodus}} skin is an edited version of the {{RLinkC|12732366|And then we'll take over the world!}} face from the Roblox catalog.
*The bandolier used by most skins between the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] and [[v1.4.0|Wanted Dead Update]] is the {{RLinkC|4464392555|Leather Bandolier}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
